title: Mexican Turkey, Rice and Bean Stuffed Peppers
summary: Sweet bell peppers are filled with spiced turkey mince, rice, black beans and tomato, then baked until tender. A satisfying gluten-free Mexican-style dinner with smoky warmth and plenty of protein.

ingredients.name: red bell peppers, halved and deseeded

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Put the rice in a saucepan with 360 ml water and a pinch of the measured salt. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes, then take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes until tender.
Place the halved peppers cut-side up in a baking dish. Bake for 10 minutes while you make the filling, just until they begin to soften.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and translucent, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the turkey mince and cook for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until no pink remains and it is lightly browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, cumin, paprika, chilli powder, oregano, remaining salt and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute so the spices smell toasted.
Add the canned tomatoes and black beans. Simmer for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is thick and saucy rather than watery.
Fold the cooked rice into the turkey and bean mixture. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.

Spoon the filling into the softened pepper halves, packing it in gently. Return the dish to the oven and bake for 18–20 minutes until the peppers are tender and the tops of the filling are slightly browned.
Scatter with chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges for squeezing over.
